lines: ーMagick Gear Hexa-Blade Style: Hexagram Spread!!
The paths of her six blades gleamed in the darkness.
Akitsu's powerful slashesーYao Bikuni staggered greatly, unable to fully endure them.
We held a dominant position in the battle. Yao Bikuni and the other Fuma Ninja Forces were being pushed back by our well-coordinated attacks.
Hebiko, the smokescreen is about to dissipate! Please!
Immediately after Hebiko breathed in deeply, she stained the area black with her octopus ink.
Perfect! Her "Mermaid's Sapphire Eyes" won't work if she can't see. Shikanosuke!! Enemy positions!?
Shikanosuke could use his Electric Jutsu as a sonar to be able to detect the enemies' positions even in the dark and through Hebiko's smokescreen.
Y-Yes!! Here I go, Electric Jutsu: Spark!!
Then, with a flash of his static electricity, he communicated the enemies' positions to the powerful attacker Akitsu.
HmmーYou're pretty good! Got it, over there!!!
Yao Bikuni's body was thrown back and fell to the ground.
She had wounds all over her body and her blood stained the crumbling asphalt.
Still, the fact that she had avoided a fatal wound showed how skilled she wasー
There were no other Fuma ninja left who could still fight.
Ugh... I am astonished. To what end wouldst one skilled as thee side with the "Diot"?
The Diot? Are you talking about that guy? I guess that's just how it turned out.
But you shouldn't take him lightly. He fully grasped your powers and gave us orders accordingly.
I mean, I'm strong enough without him though. So, how about you surrender quickly?
Akitsu looked down at Yao Bikuni who had collapsed to the ground.
Surrender? O-hoho, art thou sure about that...?
Akitsu tilted her head with a puzzled expressionーand in the next moment...
The mechanical spiders tracking their target became riled up like their web was being poked at.
That sound... no way!? The target is very close!!
Something attacked directly from the roof of an abandoned buildingーIt was Gaiza!
It had been a powerful blow. The surprise attack had sent me flying, my back crashing into rubble.
What the hell... How rare for you to use your brain...
I had been vaguely aware of it since we had arrived... no, been lured... to these ruins.
Your aim... since the beginning... was me, wasn't it.
By having Yao Bikuni and her men attack us, they shifted me into my commander role and isolated me from the other three.
It had all been to arrange for Gaiza, lying in wait, to surprise attack me.
You always have this face like you're the only smart one, so I gave you a taste of your own medicine!!
Huh... well... I'm still definitely smarter than you though...?
Gaiza's odachi came after me without mercy. The difference in close combat ability was obvious and I was completely on the defensive.
H-Hey! Are you ok, Fuma?! We're coming to rescue you!
But before they could make a move, in front of themー
What the hell! Who are these guys?! With my Magick Gear Hexa-Blade Style, I'llー
The eyes of the collapsed Yao Bikuni glowed mysteriously and caught Akitsu in their gaze.
Taking advantage of the opening, Yao Bikuni attacked Akitsu with her Ninja Art: Mermaid's Sapphire Eyes.
Her life energy was being drained. Akitsu slumped down on the ground, suddenly feeling intense fatigue.
Conversely, the wounds of the energy-absorbing Yao Bikuni were healed in an instant.
O-hohoho... a reversal of fortunes? ーHaaaah!!
Yao Bikuni's powerful blow hit Akitsu directly.
Her small body was sent flying, crashing into a wall, and she fell silent.
Hahhahaha!!! Are you frustrated? You're frustrated, aren't you, Diot?
After all, you can't do anything by yourself. Without the help of others, you're just a nobody!
While goading me on with his words, Gaiza kept swinging his odachi furiously.
Alone and with no support, all I could do was dodge.
Hehehe... Being powerless is basically a kind of sin.
Without power, you can't get anything. That's why I'll acquire greater power than anyone else.
Because of the size of Gaiza's odachi, there was an opening whenever he took a wide swing. I took advantage of that opening and slashed, butー
My ninjato just bounced off. The difference in strength was more than I had imagined.
(I guess Gaiza, too, has grown a bit!)
You're weak, "Master." You'll never make it.
Before I knew it, the cold smile that Gaiza had shown until a moment ago disappeared from his face.
It was now the face of a man who had made up his mind. And then, in a voice that only reached meー
The tip of his odachi pierced through my heart.
I felt the sensation of the open air on my punctured heart. Pain, and then heavy bleeding.
Gaiza-sama, I have apprehended the companions of the "Diot." Shall I execute them?
We accomplished our goal. Just leave them.
The sound of Gaiza and Yao Bikuni leaving. Eventually numbness and silence came over me, and I fell into a world of emptiness, all alone.
An overflowing light in all directions.
A sense of floating, then peacefulness. Was this the sensation I was enveloped by before I was born?
(If it is, then it's not bad...)
I even wanted to be wrapped up in this comfortable floating sensation foreverー
ーHaah... haah... Hebiko? Shikanosuke? Oh damn, so you guys also died...
When my vision suddenly became clear, a pain like I had been holding my breath for a long time welled up.
Before my eyes were the faces of Hebiko and Shikanosuke. Both of them were stunned, their mouths open, and they even had tears in their eyes.
It seems like he's not a Zombie...
What the... Akitsu, even you're slack-jawed...
F-Fuma, you came back to life!
